title: Project : Asylum
description: item asylum inspired wave defense minigame
body:
![Title Card](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/63c498c69fb1d0c23614c88ba0345aff736f07ae.png)

Do you want to endlessly defend against hordes of oncoming creatures from mysterious portals? No!? You're weird (jk), well, anyways, uh, you can now!

Project Asylum is wave defense minigame that can be played single or multiplayer where you fight randomised enemies with randomised weapons. 

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/dzKp6M3_dL4" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Upon starting a game, four portals are spawned which enemies will come from, deaths and points (kills) are tracked, upon death recieve a new kit of two melee weapons, a ranged weapon + a shield and armour.

Upon killing an enemy gain one point, regeneration and saturation (notified by a sound)

With a wide range of weapons referencing popular media (and some other creations of mine), this minigame features a wide range of content to keep you and your friends entertained for hours.

On top of the randomised enemy types, which can wield randomised weapons, there are also elite enemies, who are stronger, faster, and rarer.

To start, run : /function asylum:swarm_start

and to end, run : /function asylum:end

(if you wanna pvp do /team join swarm_player @a)

play item asylum [here](https://www.roblox.com/games/5670218884/item-asylum)

please note : this is a fan project, not official or affiliated with item asylum, i just like the chaos of the game
